subject.title: Incomplete turn with tool call and payloads=0 is replayUnsafe and may poison session state

question: For a `stopReason=stop` attempt with current tool activity, zero payloads, and `replaySafe=no`, should OpenClaw retain the existing fail-closed terminal response, add a structured quarantine/diagnostic record, or permit a narrowly defined retry/failover path when tool completion can be proven absent?
rationale: The correct behavior trades recovery rate against duplicate tool effects and session consistency; the field reports establish impact but do not prove a universally safe replay boundary.

options.title: Add structured quarantine first
options.body: Persist a typed terminal outcome and regression tests while continuing to avoid replaying attempts with unproven tool safety.

options.title: Permit proven-clean retry
options.body: Retry or fail over only when current-attempt evidence proves no tool side effect or delivery escaped.

options.title: Keep the terminal policy
options.body: Retain the current fail-closed behavior and document the provider/model workaround if diagnostics show incomplete tool turns are upstream-only.

recommendation.title: Add structured quarantine first
recommendation.body: Persist a typed terminal outcome and regression tests while continuing to avoid replaying attempts with unproven tool safety.

likelyOwner.reason: Their independent production evidence most directly characterizes the recovery behavior that needs to be calibrated, although source-history ownership remains unverified.
